snippet.title: R-Type Delta Longplay (PlayStation) [60 FPS]
snippet.description:
Developed by Irem and published by Agetec in 1999

Follow me on Twitter: https://twitter.com/Al82_Retro
Add me on Google+: http://bit.ly/1tPwL1u

If you love hardcore shoot 'em ups, then you're sure to love this all-3D entry in the classic R-Type series!

Be sure to check out my full review at https://al82retro.blogspot.co.uk/2017/12/game-review-r-type-delta-sony.html
#retrogaming
